title: Event
description: Immutable journal entry. Written by sources; never updated or deleted.

id.description: Generated by the client (phone) so that retries are idempotent.

source.description: Where the event came from. Known values: app, share, system, analyst, email, telegram, android_notifications, android_calls.

author.description: 'me' for the owner, 'system' for the pipeline, 'contact:<id>' for external people.

ts.description: When it happened on the device (client clock).

received_at.description: Set by the server on write.

ref.description: Reference to another record for correction / task_change / answer / action_result.

tags.description: Tags chosen by the owner at capture time; a hint for interpretation. Optional, added in v1 without breaking readers.

continuation.description: Owner's answer to the 'continuation' suggestion at capture (CONCEPT.md 2.5): does this message continue `target`? Kept when declined too, as training data.

tagging.description: Owner feedback on tag suggestions at capture (CONCEPT.md 2.2): training data for interpretation. auto and owner_on are subsets of payload.tags; owner_off is disjoint from it.

engine.description: Suggester name and version, e.g. local-v1.

auto.description: Switched on by the suggester and kept.

owner_off.description: Switched on by the suggester, switched off by the owner.

data.description: Kind-specific structured data, e.g. task_change {status, due} or correction {fields}.

reply_to.description: Event id this one replies to. A reply stays in the parent's topic.

topic_hint.description: Optional topic id chosen explicitly by the owner.
